summary: Code review PASS. All 6 acceptance criteria met. The guard is minimal and correct.
The implementation correctly follows the 'early-exit most-specific guard first' pattern: ~/path and ~ are matched before the generic startsWith('~') catch-all. This is the only viable ordering.

One Fix-Forward applied: the JSDoc note for expandStorePath() was stale — it said '~username will resolve relative to CWD, callers should reject it' but the function now throws itself. Corrected to accurately describe the new throwing behavior.

comments.note: Updated the JSDoc note in expandStorePath() to reflect the new behavior: the old note said '~username will resolve relative to CWD. This form should be rejected by callers' — now corrected to 'are rejected with a clear error message'. The fix removes a stale documentation lie that would mislead future maintainers reading the code.

The guard ordering (startsWith('~/') || === '~' first, then startsWith('~') catch-all) is correct. Inverting the order would cause '~/' and '~' to be caught by the catch-all and throw spuriously. The current order is clear and safe.
